content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 serves as an object storage solution that empowers digital creators to store and deliver their products directly to customers. Unlike traditional platforms, which often charge hefty fees for transactions and storage, R2 offers a cost-effective way to manage digital assets. This architecture is crucial for creators who want to sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital goods without incurring high platform fees. By integrating R2 with payment solutions like NOWPayments, creators can ensure immediate and secure delivery of their products upon purchase, maximizing revenue and customer satisfaction.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind using Cloudflare R2 involves a combination of storage, serverless functions, and payment processing. Digital products are stored in R2, which provides a robust and scalable environment for managing files. When a customer makes a purchase, a serverless function, such as a Cloudflare Worker, is triggered to handle the transaction via NOWPayments. This process enables automatic payment verification and product delivery without manual intervention, ensuring a smooth experience for both the creator and the customer. The infrastructure is designed to be highly available and resilient, allowing creators to focus on their products rather than the complexities of payment processing.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. Whether you are a creator in Nigeria selling ebooks or a designer in Zimbabwe offering templates, this solution provides a reliable way to monetize your work. It eliminates dependency on platforms that charge high fees, such as Gumroad's 10% per sale, allowing you to retain a larger portion of your earnings. By prioritizing sovereignty in digital commerce, this architecture caters to the needs of creators who demand both freedom and efficiency.
Now you can retain 99.5% of your sales with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The key components of this architecture include Cloudflare R2 for storage, NOWPayments for payment processing, and serverless functions for automation. R2 provides a secure and scalable environment for hosting digital products, while NOWPayments enables transaction processing with minimal fees. The integration of these elements allows for instant product delivery upon payment confirmation, creating a seamless purchasing experience for customers. Additionally, using serverless functions reduces the overhead associated with maintaining a traditional server, further enhancing the efficiency of the infrastructure. This combination ensures that creators can operate their digital storefronts without the usual complexities.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this architecture, start by setting up a Cloudflare account and creating a bucket in R2 for your digital products. Next, configure NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency transactions, ensuring you can accept multiple payment options. Once the payment processor is set up, create serverless functions to handle product delivery and payment verification. Make sure to test the entire process to ensure that customers receive their products without delay. Finally, you can enhance your setup by utilizing the Complete Builder Kit, which provides all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline your deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe can be achieved by using Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for payment processing. This approach eliminates the reliance on traditional platforms and allows creators to manage their sales directly. By utilizing these tools, creators can set up their digital storefronts efficiently and retain a larger share of their earnings.
Cloudflare R2 offers reliable and scalable storage for your digital assets.

It includes all necessary blueprints and templates, available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit empowers creators to establish a sovereign digital commerce stack that is both functional and cost-effective.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by leveraging Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for payment processing. This approach allows you to operate independently from platforms like Gumroad or Payhip.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10%. This fee structure helps you retain more revenue from your sales.
